svg.title: Arborist — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as arborist, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A handled pruning saw meets a forked branch with a short, clean cut end. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
